source: cortex: modal Desikan-Killiany (aparc_DK40) label per Schaefer2018 400p/7-network parcel, both on the 164k fsaverage surface; subcortex: Tian2020 S2 abbreviation expansion. Generated by scripts/build_region_names.py — do not hand-edit.

Vis.blurb: Areas that process what you see, from basic edges and motion to recognising objects and faces.

SomMot.blurb: Areas that handle touch, body position, and the planning and execution of movement.

DorsAttn.blurb: Areas involved in deliberately directing attention — searching a scene, tracking a moving target.

SalVentAttn.blurb: Areas that flag what is worth noticing and switch attention when something unexpected happens.

Limbic.blurb: Areas closely tied to emotion, motivation, smell, and memory for personal events.

Cont.blurb: Areas involved in holding a goal in mind, planning, and flexibly switching between tasks.

Default.blurb: Areas most active during inward-directed thought — remembering, imagining, thinking about other people.

subcortex.blurb: Structures beneath the cortex involved in memory, emotion, reward, and relaying signals to and from the cortex.
